name: RankSEO reports and keyword report detail
description: Verify the authenticated All Reports history and single keyword report experience using the configured TestSprite account and its real owned reports. Do not create an account, submit keyword research, or mock report APIs.

planSteps.description: Start with a clean signed-out browser session, navigate to /auth/sign-in, and sign in using the UI test-account credentials configured securely in the TestSprite project. Do not create a new account and do not submit an AI keyword search.
Verify sign-in succeeds and authenticated dashboard navigation becomes available.
Navigate directly to /reports.
Verify the page displays the heading "All reports", its saved-report description, and the tabs "All reports", "Keyword research", and "AI visibility".
Verify the report table displays Report, Type, Status, Created, Completed, and Action columns.

Verify the account's completed keyword report with ID 6a6c8f466b921530d0181e5e is listed as "best AI calorie tracker", displays "Keyword research", has a Completed badge, shows formatted created and completed dates, and provides a View action.

Verify the account's cancelled keyword report with ID 6a6c8b726b921530d0181e5d is listed as "best AI calorie tracker", displays a destructive Failed badge, provides a View action, and does not display "Processing · 20%".
Select the Keyword research tab.
Verify both owned keyword reports remain visible in the Keyword research tab.
Select the AI visibility tab.
Verify the empty AI visibility filter displays "No reports in this view yet." and does not display either keyword report row.
Navigate to the completed owned report at /reports/6a6c8f466b921530d0181e5e.

Verify the single-report header includes an "All reports" back action, a "Keyword research" type badge with a search icon, the formatted created date, and the formatted completed date prefixed with "Completed".

Verify the completed report renders the shared keyword report for "best AI calorie tracker", including "Overall SEO Score", Report overview, Top sources, Competitors and peers, AI prompt opportunities, and Related keyword ideas.
Use the "All reports" back action and verify it returns to /reports.
Navigate to the failed owned report at /reports/6a6c8b726b921530d0181e5d.
Verify the keyword metadata header remains visible and shows the report's created date without a completed date.
Verify the body displays "We couldn't finish this report" and "This report was cancelled before it finished.", and verify no live progress card or "20%" processing label is displayed.
Navigate to /reports/not-a-valid-report-id while remaining authenticated.
Verify the page displays "Report not found" and does not expose any saved report content.
Resize the browser viewport to approximately 390 pixels wide and revisit /reports/6a6c8f466b921530d0181e5e.
Verify the back action, report type, dates, and completed keyword report remain readable without horizontal page overflow; metadata wraps cleanly and the report content uses its mobile layout.
